# Benin

Everything this library holds for Benin, with provenance. Tilt = OLS slope of ln(rate) on wealth rank 0–1; ogcore consumes tilt ÷ 100 (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).

## Adult-mortality route for calibration

This country has its **own census measurement — use it** (rows above), not the general gradient.

## Provenance notes

- The 2013 census records deaths since 1 January 2012 (~16 months to the May census) — fine for tilts, not levels. Capture against the national death count is ~35%, wealth-uniform, so it cancels out of the tilt.
